children: Gemini saw increases in daily active users in September, even as Meta Platforms
Muse continues to see significant attention, Bank of America said.

Citing data from SensorTower, ChatGPT mobile daily active users rose 69% year-over-year (and 7% month-over-month) to 664M in September, Bank of America analyst Justin Post said. Gemini saw a 321% year-over-year increase and a 11% month-over-month increase to 151M mobile daily active users, while Meta AI jumped 646% and 2%, respectively, to 6M. Grok, which is operated by SpaceX
, saw a 145% year-over-year and 2% month-over-month increase to 2M mobile daily active users.
Conversely, Muse hit 1.96M mobile daily active users as of Oct. 5. The app is at the top of the App Store, having replaced ChatGPT since it was introduced last month.
Additionally, Google added 26M mobile daily active users, Post explained.
Gathering more data (from Statcounter), Post said that Google's share of the search market was down “slightly” month-over-month, a decline of 108 basis points, while Microsoft

saw a slight 74 basis point increase. Nonetheless, Google's market share has remained fairly steady, at 89.9% of the search market (down 44 basis points year-over-year), while Bing is at 5.3%, up 119 basis points year-over-year. In the U.S., Google had 85.2% of the search market, up 17 basis points year-over-year, but down 82 basis points month-over-month.

And data from Similarweb showed somewhat similar findings, as global daily average web visits to Google rose 3% year-over-year to 2.8B in September. Conversely, ChatGPT fell 1% year-over-year to 196M, while Gemini rose 144% year-over-year, Meta jumped 206%, and Grok rose 16%, respectively.
On a month-over-month basis, Google rose 2%, ChatGPT rose 9%, Gemini increased 4%, and Meta AI and Grok rose 17% and 2%, respectively.

Data in the U.S. showed a similar picture, with web visits up 2% year-over-year to 548M, while ChatGPT rose 15% year-over-year. Gemini saw a significant increase of 118% year-over-year, as did Meta AI, up 158% year-over-year. Grok rose 24% year-over-year. Month-over-month saw increases for Google (3%), ChatGPT (17%), Gemini (8%), Meta AI (25%), and Grok (1%).
Post, who has a Buy rating and a $430 price target on Alphabet, added that Google could benefit from the rise of agentic AI, with the potential for it to “accelerate” search.

“While agentic adoption could impact traditional search behavior, we believe agentic will likely expand overall online activity by enabling users to more seamlessly complete tasks/purchases,” Post explained. “While we think Google remains well positioned for the AI transition given extensive distribution, 1P data & merchant relationships (we maintain our Buy rating), Google will need to carefully manage its agentic launches to not [disrupt] traffic monetization. We expect Google’s potential agentic initiatives to be an analyst focus area on the upcoming (10/28) earnings call.”

title: ChatGPT, Gemini see daily active user increases as Meta's Muse nears 2M: BofA
